entities.summary: Samuel Blais is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a winger for the Laval Rocket of the American Hockey League while under contract to the Montreal Canadiens of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected in the sixth round, 176th overall, by the St. Louis Blues in the 2014 NHL entry draft. Blais has also previously played for the New York Rangers and Toronto Maple Leafs.
